about.title: About Us
about.description1: PT Equityworld Futures (EWF) positions itself as an investment partner that prioritizes trust and professionalism in the futures trading industry. With a strong focus on service quality and continuous education, EWF helps clients navigate market opportunities in a more guided and secure way.
about.description2: Since commencing operations in 2005, EWF has continued to grow and expand its services, now operating seven offices across Jakarta, Surabaya, Semarang, Manado, and Cirebon. As a licensed futures brokerage company, EWF is registered and supervised by the Commodity Futures Trading Regulatory Agency (Bappebti), the Financial Services Authority (OJK), and Bank Indonesia (BI), and is a member of the Jakarta Futures Exchange (JFX) and Indonesia Clearing House (KBI). With a strong regulatory foundation, EWF is committed to delivering a transparent, accountable, and high-standard trading experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become a leading and trusted futures brokerage firm with modern and transparent operational standards, providing strategic value to the development of the industry and the national economy.

mission.title: Mission
items: Provide professional and secure futures trading services with a high standard of integrity.
Develop the quality of human resources to deliver competent and competitive services.
Implement transparent and accountable corporate governance.
Expand access to education and literacy on futures trading for the public.
Optimize technology to support efficient operations and a better overall client experience.

integrity.title: Professional Integrity
integrity.description: Uphold high ethical standards and maintain consistency in actions and decisions across all company activities.

customerSatisfaction.title: Customer-Centric Focus
customerSatisfaction.description: Prioritize clients’ needs and investment objectives through responsive, accurate, and transparent services.

compliance.title: Disciplined Compliance
compliance.description: Conduct all business processes within the regulatory framework with strong and sustainable internal controls.

innovation.title: Continuous Innovation
innovation.description: Drive the development of technology, products, and workflows to deliver an increasingly efficient and competitive trading experience.
